end.text: After Anne Boleyn died, King Henry VIII had four more wives! Elizabeth and Catherine Parr, Henry’s final wife, became very close.

end.text: Catherine Parr encouraged Elizabeth’s education. She was taught by the best teachers in the country and could speak six languages! Catherine Parr also helped Henry to change his mind and allow Elizabeth to be in line for the throne again.

instruction.text: When Elizabeth was only thirteen years old, her father, Henry VIII, died. This timeline shows the monarchs who came after him. Fill in the gaps.

hint.text: A monarch is a king or a queen.
hint.label: Monarch

atoms.b: After King Henry VIII died, his first ((++son daughter)) Edward became King of England. Edward was only ((++nine sixty)) years old when he became king!
A few years later, Edward became ill and died. Elizabeth’s older sister ((++Mary Susan)) became Queen of England. She was the first female monarch.
In 1558, after Mary died, Elizabeth became ((++Queen Princess)) of England.
